description: This file defines a mock class for the ISubscriptionHandler interface using the Turtle mocking framework. It declares mock methods for subscribing, unsubscribing, publishing, and thread management functions related to subscription handling.

classes.name: ISubscriptionHandlerMock
classes.description: A mock implementation of the ISubscriptionHandler interface for unit testing, utilizing the Turtle mock framework

methods.name: subscribe
methods.description: Mocks the subscription method with four parameters

methods.name: unsubscribe
methods.description: Mocks the method to unsubscribe a single subscription

methods.name: unsubscribeAll
methods.description: Mocks the method to unsubscribe all subscriptions

methods.name: publishForVSSPath
methods.description: Mocks publishing data for a specific VSS path

methods.name: isThreadRunning
methods.description: Mocks checking if the thread is running, returns a boolean

methods.name: subThreadRunner
methods.description: Mocks the thread runner function, returns void*

methods.name: addPublisher
methods.description: Mocks adding a publisher object to the subscription handler
